description: Self-hosted deployment platform: push to git, get a running app with TLS, logs, metrics, and rollback on your own Linux servers. CLI, MCP server, app.yaml spec, and HTTP API.
rules: Drive Levelrail with levelrail-cli or the levelrail-mcp server; both read the API token from APP_API_TOKEN and the instance URL from APP_API_URL, and a token must never be written to a file or a commit.

After a deploy, block on `levelrail-cli apps wait <app>` instead of assuming it worked, and read `levelrail-cli apps deploys show <app> <deploy-id>` for the structured failure before changing anything.
Preview changes with `--dry-run`, `levelrail-cli apps preflight <app>`, or the MCP `plan_change` tool before applying anything destructive.
Set secrets with `levelrail-cli apps secrets set <app> --env-file <path>` from a git-ignored file; secret values are write-only and are never read back.
The app spec is app.yaml, version 1; validate it with the same parser the control plane uses via `levelrail-cli init --dry-run` or `apps preflight`.
Roll back first when production is down: list deploys with `levelrail-cli apps deploys list <app>`, then `levelrail-cli apps deploys rollback-to <app> <deploy-id>`; then investigate.
Start the MCP server in the smallest mode that works: agent-core, read-only, standard, then full.
